summary: First-pass full-stack test for Dr.D. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass (auth, role protection, doctor settings, patient queue join/duplicate/checkin/cancel, walkin, call-next, delay, daily_cap, accepting toggle, staff CRUD + login, notifications, ETA math with ahead>=2 raising eta_min). Frontend: patient flow (login -> join queue (#11, Pos 3rd, ETA ~20m) -> check-in -> cancel), notifications bell+items, Dai chat SSE streamed a response, doctor dashboard (current-patient-card, call-next, delay +15m, Settings tab with avg/cap/accepting/save, Staff tab with name/email/password/create), staff dashboard (send-next, add-walkin flow succeeded), register page role picker with doctor-specific fields all verified. Mobile viewport loads. Owner settings reset to defaults post-test.

issues: Visible placeholder 'Dr. [Your Name]' / '[Your Clinic Name]' / '[City]' is intentional per spec but surfaces to patients too in doctor list; consider replacing with real seeded values or hiding bracketed placeholders in public doctor list.

action_items: Optional: seed owner doctor with a real-looking name/clinic/city instead of bracketed placeholders so patient-facing doctor-list is cleaner.
Optional: /api/clinic/delay has no explicit endpoint to directly SET delay_min; only increments allowed. Minor hardening—consider clamping or allowing direct set for admin reset.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~775 lines) is approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider splitting into modules (auth, queue, clinic, dai).
login_attempts counter is not reset on partial failures that reach exactly 5 before window expires; consider using TTL index on login_attempts.
set_auth cookies use SameSite=None,Secure=True which is correct for cross-site; good.
No rate limit on /api/dai/chat SSE endpoint; a patient could spam Dai; consider per-user rate limit.
dispatch_alerts runs on every /patient/queue poll (5s) and iterates all entries — fine for small clinics but O(N) notifications writes should be batched or guarded.
/api/doctors is unauthenticated and lists all doctor emails + phone; consider hiding email/phone from public listing.
